evals.name: copy-all-button
evals.prompt: 板ページのヘッダーに、全セクションをまとめてクリップボードにコピーするボタンを付けて。
evals.expected_output: HeaderSlot button following SectionActions feedback pattern.
assertions: The button is inserted from the board side via HeaderSlot (AppHeader / __root header is not modified to know about the board)
The icon uses the existing Svg/Tabler-path approach; no new icon package or @mantine/notifications is added
Has a Japanese aria-label and Japanese tooltip text
Success/failure feedback follows the SectionActions pattern (icon/tooltip change + live region), not a new toast system
Uses onMouseDown={keepEditorFocus} (or equivalent reuse) so clicking does not blur the editor
No hard-coded hex colours in the new code
The feedback button logic is shared with SectionActions (extracted/reused), not duplicated

evals.name: delete-all-sections
evals.prompt: ユーザーメニューに「すべてのセクションを削除」を追加して。
evals.expected_output: Destructive action using the established undo or confirm-modal pattern and copy.
assertions: The deletion can be undone via a 元に戻す action (BottomLeftNotice / useUndoableDelete)
A past-tense Japanese result message (〜しました) is shown after deleting
The action is disabled or guarded while offline
No new dependencies are added to package.json
The header/UserMenu does not import board route internals directly
The menu item is actually wired: any provider/slot it depends on sits above both the header and the board route (e.g. in __root.tsx), so it works on the board page

evals.name: landing-contact-link
evals.prompt: ランディングページのフッターに「お問い合わせ」リンクを足して。
evals.expected_output: Footer link that reuses CONTACT_URL/ContactLink and matches the footer style.
assertions: Reuses CONTACT_URL or ContactLink from src/components/ContactLink.tsx instead of hard-coding an address
Matches the existing footer items (Anchor size="xs", the ・ separator)
The link label is Japanese (お問い合わせ)
No hard-coded hex colours and no new dependencies
npm run lint and npm run typecheck pass
